This upload collects Asoko Asoko Asoko chapters in the publication order, combining chapters 1, 4, 6, 7, and 9 from Scholar Comics Deluxe "Asoko Asoko Asoko" https://e-hentai.org/g/3594775/417fc36f32/ and the World Comics "Nyan Nyan Princess" Physical: https://e-hentai.org/g/3915183/67cb3c33d9/ Digital: https://e-hentai.org/g/3612656/8426b6a2ea

I have included duplicates for pages that were censored/bad level. Unfortunately, chapters 1, 4, 6, 7, and 9 are censored. Also, a few magazine pages and info about the publication.
